_readme: Actions designed with Gemini, recorded for the offline demo.

a mobile ct unit that visits northern la.idea: A mobile CT unit that visits northern Lapland every month

estimate.rationale: Finland has low primary care CT access (S02) and >400 km travel distances (S03). However, a Danish RCT found direct GP CT access did not significantly reduce diagnostic time (S17), and a monthly schedule introduces up to a 30-day wait. Thus, P2 reduction is near zero, with a modest reduction in P4 travel-attributable days.
estimate.label: Monthly mobile CT unit

trail: Read the national cancer strategy, the roadmap and the evidence notes
Matched the idea to roadmap action 2.3.4 (p.46)
Estimated the effect on primary care, diagnosis (low confidence)
Ran the pathway simulation for Lapland, for Patient B and for all 22 regions

a sameday phone line where public health.idea: A same-day phone line where public health centre doctors can book a lung specialist assessment for suspected cancer

estimate.rationale: Targets public health centre referrals (public_route). eConsult studies (S15) show rapid specialist responses (hours to 4 days) and 11-19 day wait reductions, but are non-cancer specific. Fast-track pathways (S14, S24) cut diagnostic waits ~29%, though Sweden's 36% compliance (S07) shows implementation limits. Conservatively, we estimate a 15% reduction in P2 (6/41d) and 20% in P3 (2.4/12d).
estimate.label: GP-to-specialist same-day booking line

volunteer drivers and a named contact pe.idea: Volunteer drivers and a named contact person for lung cancer patients who live alone

estimate.rationale: Observational studies of nurse navigators (S16) show a ~21% reduction (48 to 38 days) from referral to treatment; we conservatively estimate a 14% reduction in P4 and P5 for patients living alone (navigation_barrier), aligned with Roadmap 1.2.3. Volunteer drivers mitigate travel barriers (S18, S27, ROADMAP p.13), conservatively cutting distance-attributable delays in P4 and P5 by 15%.
estimate.label: Drivers and named coordinator

trail: Read the national cancer strategy, the roadmap and the evidence notes

Estimated the effect on diagnosis, starting treatment (low confidence)
Ran the pathway simulation for Lapland, for Patient B and for all 22 regions

a nurse phone line that calls every pati.idea: A nurse phone line that calls every patient referred for suspected lung cancer within two days

estimate.rationale: Nurse navigation studies (S16) show 10-19 day referral-to-treatment reductions. An immediate intake call streamlines P3 specialist booking and prepares P4 diagnostic tests. We conservatively project 5-25% reductions in P3 and 3-15% in P4, discounting for real-world implementation friction (S07) and limited scope [ROADMAP p.32].
estimate.label: Nurse Referral Intake Line
